AND ( min_area IS NULL OR min_area <= 0 OR (#{plantArea} IS NOT NULL AND #{plantArea} >= min_area) )
AND ( require_bank_card IS NULL OR require_bank_card = 0 OR #{hasBankCard} = 1 )

AND ( require_land_cert IS NULL OR require_land_cert = 0 OR #{hasLandCert} = 1 )
